bugs_or_flaws: Note: Random baseline R2 values (~0.8-0.95) for Crippen/Ring properties are unusually high, suggesting potential label leakage or task triviality in the probe setup (e.g., atom identity signal preserved even with random weights). However, this does not invalidate the *relative* collapse observed in A2 (drop from 0.86 to 0.63 vs flat Random), so claims remain supported.

claim_assessments.claim: A2 undergoes significant representation space contraction at Layer 12 compared to the peak expansion at Layer 8.
claim_assessments.reason: PR drops from 216.8 (L8) to 21.9 (L12). Anisotropy increases (0.37 -> 0.66). Matches T14a reference pattern.

claim_assessments.claim: Continuous physicochemical properties lose linear decodability at Layer 12.
claim_assessments.reason: Linear R² drops from 0.863 (L4) to 0.633 (L12). MLP error also rises significantly.

claim_assessments.claim: Discrete topological features survive Layer 12 collapse better than continuous properties.
claim_assessments.reason: Ring5 Linear R² remains >0.927 at L12 (vs Crippen ~0.63). O-Neighbor MLP stays >0.94.

claim_assessments.claim: The collapse is a learned dynamic, not an architectural artifact of depth alone.
claim_assessments.reason: A2 PR trajectory (Low->High->Low) differs from A2_Random (Flat ~10). Random R² stable; A2 degrades.
